title: Each tile's figure matches a hand calculation from known records
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. The Dash Shop data set exists, all created today in location ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop, where nothing else is invoiced or clocked this month: work order 1 for customer ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Fleet, Service Advisor ZZAUTOTEST Advisor X, one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour with Tech Time 1.50 and technician ZZAUTOTEST Tech One, a part with Sell Price $50.00, and ZZAUTOTEST Tech One clocked exactly 2.50 hours on it; work order 2 for ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Fleet, Service Advisor ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Y, one labor line of 1.00 hour at $100.00 an hour with Tech Time 1.00 and technicians ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two, a part with Sell Price $160.00, Tech One clocked exactly 0.25 hours and Tech Two exactly 0.75 hours on it. Neither work order has shop supplies, a fee or a discount; both are invoiced and not paid. Totals: invoices $250.00 and $260.00; 3.00 labor hours billed; 2.50 technician hours on the lines; 3.50 clocked hours; no internal (non work order) time.
  4. ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two belongs to a department whose time clock is on, so they can clock internal (non work order) time.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: if ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop already exists with exactly this data, reuse it. Otherwise: (a) location: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop, the address fields, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 % > Save & Close (if a location with this name already exists, reuse it only if it still matches the precondition). It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. (b) staff: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member, four times: ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two with Role Technician and Time Clock on, ZZAUTOTEST Advisor X and ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Y with Role Service Advisor; each with Location ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop and a Department > Save & Close. Give each technician an email address you can open: they must accept the invitation email and set a password so you can sign in as them in a private window. (c) customers: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save, for ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Fleet and ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Fleet. (d) each work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = the technician(s), Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time and Tech Time as above, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; set Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; on the line click Add Part and add a part with the Sell Price above (it must show In stock, or be ordered and received, before you can invoice). (e) clocked time: sign in as each technician in a private window > open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start, then Stop > Clock Out; then, as Admin, the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows). (f) on each work order: on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice).
  • For 4: choose that department when you create ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two (New Staff Member > Departments); profile icon > Settings > Departments shows which departments have Clock Time Enabled = Yes (for example Training).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu with ZZAUTOTEST Dash Shop selected and every tile on its default range.
  2. Read the Revenue headline and its supporting line.
  3. Read the Billing Efficiency headline and its supporting line.
  4. Read the Technician Efficiency headline and its supporting line.
  5. Read the Technician Utilization headline and its supporting line.
  6. Read the Sales by Customer headline.
  7. Click View details on Billing Efficiency and read the Advisor Analysis table rows.
  8. Click View details on Technician Efficiency and read the table rows.
  9. Sign in as ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two in a private window, click Clock In in the top bar, choose the department (not a work order), then clock out. As Admin, set that record to exactly 0.50 hours in Reports > Timesheet Activities (e.g. 15:00 to 15:30 today).
  10. Reload the dashboard and read the Technician Utilization headline and supporting line.
  11. Click View details on Technician Utilization and read the table rows.
  12. Read the At Risk Customers headline.
  13. Clean up: delete the 0.50-hour internal record again in Reports > Timesheet Activities, so the data set is back to its base state for other cases.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Revenue reads $510.00 (250.00 + 260.00) with the supporting line "Parts 41% · Labor 59%". Parts are 50.00 + 160.00 = 210.00, and 210 ÷ 510 = 41.2%, so 41%. Labor is 200.00 + 100.00 = 300.00, and 300 ÷ 510 = 58.8%, so 59%.
  • Billing Efficiency reads 85.71% with "3.00 Invoiced / 3.50 Clocked" (labor hours billed 2.00 + 1.00 = 3.00; clocked 2.50 + 0.25 + 0.75 = 3.50; 3.00 ÷ 3.50 × 100 = 85.71).
  • Technician Efficiency reads 71.43% with "2.50 Invoiced Tech Hrs / 3.50 Clocked" (technician time on the lines 1.50 + 1.00 = 2.50; 2.50 ÷ 3.50 × 100 = 71.43). It differs from Billing Efficiency because technician time is not the same as billed labor hours.
  • Advisor Analysis rows: ZZAUTOTEST Advisor X, Worked Hours 2.50, Invoiced Hrs 2.00, Billing Efficiency 80.00%, ELR $80.00 ($200.00 labor ÷ 2.50 hours). ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Y, Worked Hours 1.00, Invoiced Hrs 1.00, Billing Efficiency 100.00%, ELR $100.00 ($100.00 ÷ 1.00).
  • Technician Efficiency rows show work order 2's technician time split by each technician's share of the clocked time on that line (Tech One 0.25 of 1.00 clocked = 0.25 hours, Tech Two 0.75 hours). ZZAUTOTEST Tech One: Clocked Hrs 2.75, Invoiced Tech Hrs 1.75 (1.50 + 0.25), Efficiency 63.64%. ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two: Clocked Hrs 0.75, Invoiced Tech Hrs 0.75, Efficiency 100.00%.
  • Before the internal time, Technician Utilization reads 100.00% with "3.50 WO Hrs / 3.50 Clocked".
  • After 0.50 internal hours, Technician Utilization reads 87.50% with "3.50 WO Hrs / 4.00 Clocked" (3.50 ÷ (3.50 + 0.50) × 100 = 87.50). Table: Tech One WO Hours 2.75, Internal Hours 0.00, Total Hours 2.75, Utilization % 100.00%. Tech Two WO Hours 0.75, Internal Hours 0.50, Total Hours 1.25, Utilization % 60.00%.
  • Sales by Customer reads "2 customers" (Alpha Fleet and Bravo Fleet, each counted once).
  • At Risk Customers reads 0 for this workplace: both customers were invoiced today, so neither invoice is 120 or more days old.
  • Each figure equals its matching report: Sales, Service Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency (Invoiced), Technician Utilization and Sales By Customer. At Risk Customers has no report.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (Story 3, Measure Formulas and Report Parity); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 3 (requirement S3-R2 and its table). Design canvas boards 05_Billing_After, 06_TechEff_After and 07_TechUtil_After for the table columns.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R2: “Each measure is calculated as defined in the table below.”
  • S3-R2 table: Revenue: “Revenue | Sum of invoice subtotals in the selected range, before any discount and before tax, minus credit memos. Shown to the cent. | Sales report”
  • S3-R2 table: Billing Efficiency: “Billing Efficiency | Invoiced hours divided by worked hours, times 100, for the selected range. | Service Advisor Analysis report”
  • S3-R2 table: Technician Efficiency: “Technician Efficiency | Invoiced technician hours divided by clocked hours, times 100, for the selected range. Each work order line's technician time is split across the technicians who worked it, in proportion to each technician's share of the clocked time on that line. | Technician Efficiency report (Invoiced)”
  • S3-R2 table: Technician Utilization: “Technician Utilization | Work-order hours divided by the sum of work-order hours and internal hours, times 100, for the selected range. | Technician Utilization report”
  • S3-R2 table: Sales by Customer (count): “Sales by Customer (count) | The count of distinct customers with sales in the selected range. | Sales By Customer report”
  • S3-R2 table: At Risk Customers (count): “At Risk Customers (count) | The count of customers whose most recent invoice is at least the selected number of days old, and who also have either two or more lifetime invoices or some revenue in the last twelve months. | None (dashboard-only)”
  • S3-R2 table: ELR (on the Billing Efficiency chart): “ELR (on the Billing Efficiency chart) | Labor sales divided by worked hours, per advisor. | Service Advisor Analysis report”
  • Terminology (worked hours): “the time technicians actually clocked, from their time records.”
  • Terminology (invoiced technician hours): “the technician time recorded on work order lines. Used by Technician Efficiency. This is a different figure from invoiced hours.”
  • Terminology (internal hours): “clocked time not tied to a work order, such as internal tasks.”
  • S3 context note (At Risk): “At Risk Customers has no report, so parity does not apply to it; its formula in this table is the only definition of the measure.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
